issue: Standardised FCF omits purchases of contract fulfilment assets (client investments; USD492m in FY25). Compass treats these as capex (total capex 1,384). Yahoo CapitalExpenditure (892 FY25; 1,076 TTM) is PP&E plus intangibles only. FCF_std is 2,277 against company FCF of 1,865 (FY25). EBITDA, which carries CFA amortisation in D&A, is therefore paired with a capex figure that leaves out the matching cash outflow.
suggested_fix: Deduct CFA purchases (~USD520m TTM est. = 492 x 1.07). This gives fcf_std ~1,751 and fcf_yield 3.1% (not 4.0%). Base 5y IRR falls from 12.0% to 11.3% at g=8%, and to ~10.2% at g=7%. Add a capex_incl_cfa field to research/ifrs_cashflow_classification.csv and use it.
evidence: research/ifrs_cashflow_classification.csv CPG notes; Compass FY25 RNS p21/p41 https://pdf.dfcfw.com/pdf/H22_AN202511251788056882_1.pdf

issue: The record says the AccuLynx deal was terminated. The Delaware Chancery Court (10-Aug-2026) and Delaware Supreme Court (23-Oct-2026) ruled that Verisk must keep pursuing FTC clearance and must close the USD2.35bn deal if it is cleared. The Q3-26 call (5-Nov-2026) calls it pending. research/verification/VRSK.json already flagged this, but the change never reached the qual record, gates or scenarios.
suggested_fix: Treat AccuLynx as a pending debt-funded acquisition. Pro-forma net debt/EBITDAaL is ~3.6x (vs 2.3x), above the 3.5x services limit, so G1 = B pending a deleveraging path. Add an acquisition-return sensitivity and update bear points and thesis breakers.

issue: Base organic growth sits at the top of new company guidance. On 3-Nov-2026 Coloplast cut its 2030 ambition to 5-7% organic growth p.a. (from 7-8%) and guided FY26/27 organic growth of 5-7%. Q4 FY25/26 organic growth was 5%.
suggested_fix: Use 6.0% (guidance midpoint). Base 5y IRR falls from 12.4% to 11.6% (11.1% with normalised FCF).

issue: The 50/50 rule is driven by 2022-23 inflation and hard-market years (9%, 9%). Management guided 2026 underlying growth 'similar to 2025' (4%). 9M-26 growth was 5%, Q3 Reinsurance was -6% and property rates were -10%.
suggested_fix: Use 4.5%. Base 5y IRR falls from 10.2% to 8.5%, below the 9% hurdle, and the buy-below price falls to ~USD195.

issue: Above FY2027 company guidance of 6-7% cc organic growth (AST guidance cut to 6-7% on 4-Nov-2026).
suggested_fix: Use 6.5%. Base IRR falls from 10.8% to 9.8%.

issue: scores.csv (01:54:55) predates research/verification/CPG.json (01:58:54), so CPG ran on an unverified 2-year series. The verified series adds FY22 37.5% and FY23 18.8% (post-COVID reopening), which would push the uncapped rule to 11.7%. The 2022+ median is not a valid run-rate for Compass. The company guides ~7% for FY26 and mid-to-high single digits for the medium term.
suggested_fix: Re-run rank.py after verification. Override CPG g_base to 7% (guidance) and document the exclusion of reopening years. Base IRR with g=7% and CFA-adjusted FCF is ~10.2%.

issue: FY25/26 OCF of 8,006 jumped from 6,645 (FY24/25). The jump comes from a +355 working-capital inflow (vs -850 to -1,030 in prior years) and lower interest paid. FCF/NI of 2.0x reflects NI depressed by the DKK3.0bn Kerecis impairment. Using one favourable year capitalises a working-capital release.
suggested_fix: Use the average of FY24/25 (4,937) and FY25/26 (6,147), ~5,540, which gives an FCF yield of 5.0% (not 5.5%) and cuts base IRR by ~0.4pp.

issue: PitchBook EV for Compass (USD40.3bn, TTM 2Q26) is ~37% below the bottom-up EV (USD63.9bn). Implied shares are 1,154m vs 1,700m reported, which breaches the +/-3% tolerance in methodology section 10 without a flag. The point-in-time multiple series (11.7x now, 10y median 12.5x, p25 10.2x) and the 5y attribution (multiple_t0 184x, flagged abnormal) are unreliable.
suggested_fix: Enforce the +/-3% test by flagging or dropping the PitchBook EV series. Rebuild CPG history from reported shares x price. Do not use CPG multiple percentiles in the valuation pillar or bear case.
evidence: PitchBook profile 10153-45 (EV USD40,306.5m; EBITDA USD4,040m TTM 2Q2026) https://my.pitchbook.com/profile/10153-45/company/profile

issue: Compass switched its LSE trading currency to USD effective 1-Apr-2026 (RNS 18-Mar and 1-Apr-2026), not 2-Jan-2026. Yahoo shows a synthetic USD series from 2-Jan and a +7.6% one-day move on 1-Apr-2026 (27.46 to 29.55) that is likely an artefact. Proactive reported 2,050p on 5-Feb-2026, against a Yahoo-implied ~2,179p.
suggested_fix: Rebuild Jan-Mar 2026 from GBp closes x USDGBP, set the override end to 2026-03-31, and re-run returns, correlations and attribution for CPG.

issue: A lease cash proxy (current lease liability 121.7) was used even though the press release discloses combined lease repayments incl. interest of 157.8 (financing). Lease interest sits in neither OCF nor interest_paid, so it is never deducted from FCF.
suggested_fix: Deduct 157.8. fcf_std becomes 636.6 (not 672.7), FCF yield 4.8%, and base IRR falls from 12.6% to 12.4%.
evidence: research/ifrs_cashflow_classification.csv BVI row; BV FY2025 press release p21/p23

issue: There is no disclosed organic series. The ESTIMATE uses the 5y reported revenue CAGR less 3pp, which the Stericycle acquisition (Nov-2024) inflates. Q3-26 internal growth of 5.9% includes USD112m of energy surcharges and mandated fees (pass-through). C&D volume is roughly flat, core price is 5.8% and yield is 3.4%.
suggested_fix: Use internal growth ex surcharges, ~4-4.5%. Base IRR falls from 8.6% to ~7.5%. WM is below the 9% hurdle on both the file and the corrected assumptions.
evidence: research/qual/WM.json kpis (S1 = WM Q3-26 SEC filing)

issue: ebitda_adj adds back Yahoo 'unusual items' that recur every year (CPG 347/687/430/484; BN 719 TTM). CPG EV/EBITDAaL_adj is 13.8x vs 15.4x reported; BN is 10.2x vs 12.0x. This feeds p_valuation through peer_rel_multiple. Scenario IRRs are unaffected because exit EV scales with the entry multiple.
suggested_fix: Add back only items the company flags as non-recurring and that are absent in at least 2 of the last 3 years. Otherwise rank on reported EBITDAaL.

issue: Exit equity (multiple x EBITDA - nd0 + cumFCF) leaves out the minorities and associates that sit inside EV0, so the time-0 identity is off by mino-inv (WM -710, BN -858, MMC +235). FCF is accumulated without any return, and dividend withholding tax is ignored.
suggested_fix: Subtract minorities and add investments at exit. Note the WHT drag (~0.2-0.3pp p.a. on US/FR/DK names held by a UK investor).

issue: The Yahoo annual series lacks FY2024/25, so 3y cumulative FCF/NI is NaN, G4 is untested and p_cash rests on fewer inputs.
suggested_fix: Fill FY24/25 from research/ifrs_cashflow_classification.csv and AR 2024/25.

issue: Split-year labels such as '2024/25 (Sep)' are parsed to the first year, so 'y>=2022' starts at FY2022/23. The series is shifted one year relative to calendar-year names. Not material here, but inconsistent.
suggested_fix: Parse the year in which the fiscal period ends.

issue: COLO and ROL show a 0.0 drawdown for 2020. The method takes the month-end minimum against the 31-Jan-2020 level, not peak to trough. Actual 2020 peak-to-trough (adj close) was COLO -21.1%, ROL -22.5% and CPG -49.6%, so the weighted 2020 drawdown (-15%) is understated.
suggested_fix: Use the daily peak-to-trough within the window.

issue: The 'global index' holding is proxied by the S&P 500 TR, which is US-only. This misstates correlation and USD overlap with a true global (MSCI World/ACWI) fund.
suggested_fix: Use a GBP-quoted MSCI World/ACWI ETF series as the proxy.

issue: The recall value is wrong. Rollins reported FY2024 organic growth of 7.9% (revenue +10.3%, acquisitions +3.1%). FY2023 8.2% is also recall and unverified.
suggested_fix: Replace with 10-K/release values. The effect on g_base is ~+0.1pp because the interim blend dominates.

issue: g_base of 7.5% rests on two recall-sourced years. FY2024 10.2% is confirmed (BV release 25-Feb-2025). FY2023 8.5% was not re-verified. BVI has no verification file, and H1-2026 organic growth was 5.0% (Q2 5.5%).
suggested_fix: Create research/verification/BVI.json. A ~6.25% base is more defensible; base IRR falls from 12.6% to ~11.1% including the lease fix.

issue: There is a pending sale of Oil & Petrochemicals and Coal T&I (~EUR450m 2025 revenue, ~7% of group, margin-dilutive, closing by end Q1-2027) and a planned exit from Government Services (provision booked in H1-26). Snapshot and growth series are not pro forma.
suggested_fix: Note the pro forma perimeter. The company says the sale is broadly earnings-neutral and accretive to organic growth and margin.

issue: Management attributes the 2026 misses to fewer customers searching digital channels and to AI-driven search changing lead acquisition, which it calls structural. Q3 residential organic growth was 2.3%. This is an AI-disintermediation effect on customer acquisition and contradicts I1 = 4.
suggested_fix: Lower I1 to 2-3 with evidence. Add AI-search lead-generation disruption to the thesis breakers, and note the securities-law firm investigations (Jul/Aug 2026).

issue: Confirmed: LOR sold 17,391,305 shares (3.61%) at USD57.50 on 12-Nov-2025. A concurrent company repurchase was not confirmed in this check.
suggested_fix: Replace the recall source with PitchBook deal 312987-79T or the 8-K.

issue: Yahoo OrdinarySharesNumber is flat to up (1,697m to 1,700m) despite multi-year buybacks and may include treasury shares. Not independently verified; the PitchBook profile gives no share count.
suggested_fix: Check against the latest RNS 'Total voting rights', which excludes treasury shares.

issue: The Alcon Q3-26 call transcript is dated 11-Nov-2026 (21:42 UTC). If results came out after the SIX close, the snapshot pairs post-close fundamentals with a pre-release price (minor look-ahead).
suggested_fix: Confirm the release time. Otherwise use the 12-Nov price or Q2 fundamentals.

issue: Yahoo gives no CapitalLeaseObligations for WM, so finance leases stay inside 'pre-lease' net debt while other names exclude all leases. Finance-lease principal is not deducted from WM FCF. This is conservative on EV and slightly generous on FCF.
suggested_fix: Take the finance-lease liability and principal from the 10-K and treat them consistently with other names.

issue: Missing SBC for COLO and BVI is treated as zero dilution, while US names carry 0.2-0.7% p.a. This is a small bias in favour of the European names.
suggested_fix: Populate SBC from the annual report share-based payment notes.

issue: Basket 5y GBP vol of 14.2% is above the S&P 500 TR proxy's 12.9%. Correlation is 0.44 with the index proxy and 0.39 with the FTSE100. Correlation is low only against the travel holdings (0.14-0.22). MMC, VRSK and WM have pairwise correlations of 0.58-0.68, forming one US defensive/insurance cluster.
suggested_fix: Present the basket as a factor bet on de-rated quality defensives, not as risk reduction. Cap the US insurance-linked cluster.

issue: The Atos/Kerecis prices and Louis-Hansen control are marked 'recalled'. The verification corrected control (Coloplast Fonden after the 1-Oct-2026 gift). Kerecis book value is now ~DKK6bn after the DKK3.0bn impairment (23-Apr-2026).
